judgment_refs.phrase: The City Traffic Engineer is authorized to determine and designate streets, or specific lanes thereon
judgment_refs.note: Original municipal authorization and exact lane designation must be reviewed; a synthetic device source cannot establish authority.

judgment_refs.phrase: during one period and the opposite direction during another period of the day
judgment_refs.note: Retain the original civil-time source and period-indexed designation; do not infer a schedule from the case name.

judgment_refs.phrase: regardless of the centerline of the roadway
judgment_refs.note: Keep the original centerline observation separate from the temporary device direction when present.

judgment_refs.phrase: in violation of such markings, signs, barriers, or other devices so placed in accordance with this Section
judgment_refs.note: Preserve original indication, vehicle trajectory and full camera views; legal violation is unresolved.

sweep_specs.rationale: The existing twelve exact cases provide categorical direction, device and period comparisons; a source-backed numeric physical sweep remains to be constructed without creating a legal cutoff.
missing_inputs: Worker must construct finite numerical variation cases, source-based measurement axis, and CPU proofs; current categorical cases do not form a numerical grid.
